explanation: The book defines the lapse α as how much proper time elapses per unit coordinate time along the normal n^μ. The shift βⁱ instead encodes how the spatial coordinates shift between slices; γ_ij is the induced 3-metric on Σ_t; and K_ij is the extrinsic curvature measuring how the slice bends in spacetime. Both α and βⁱ are gauge variables.
